Name: Calculated terrain mask
Description: Builds a read-only terrain mask from the generated height field. Each source exposes only the controls that affect that calculation.

Source.Name: MaskType
Source.Label: Source
Source.Description: Select the terrain measurement used to calculate this mask.
Source.Tooltip: Calculated masks are generated from the current terrain and can be copied into the painted mask for manual editing.

Buttons.Label: Reset recommended
Buttons.Description: Restore the recommended starting values for the selected mask source.

Types.Name: Height range
Types.Description: Selects terrain whose height falls inside the chosen interval.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Range
Params.Description: Minimum and maximum terrain height to include.
Params.Tooltip: The range is softly feathered at both ends.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the range edges as a fraction of the selected range width.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values make the mask transition gradually instead of cutting off abruptly.

Types.Name: Slope range
Types.Description: Selects terrain by slope angle in degrees.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Slope degrees
Params.Description: Minimum and maximum slope angle to include.
Params.Tooltip: 0 degrees is flat and 90 degrees is vertical.

Params.Name: SampleRadius
Params.Label: Slope sample radius
Params.Description: Controls the terrain distance used for the stable slope estimate.
Params.Tooltip: Larger values reduce small-scale noise but soften narrow features.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers both ends of the slope interval relative to its width.
Params.Tooltip: Use a small value to keep slope boundaries crisp without creating speckle.

Types.Name: Aspect / direction
Types.Description: Selects slopes facing a chosen compass direction.

Params.Name: Direction
Params.Label: Direction
Params.Description: Center direction in degrees around the terrain map.
Params.Tooltip: Directions wrap around, so -10 degrees and 350 degrees are equivalent.

Params.Name: DirectionWidth
Params.Label: Direction width
Params.Description: Angular width on either side of the selected direction.
Params.Tooltip: Wider values include more slope orientations.

Params.Name: EdgeSoftness
Params.Label: Edge softness
Params.Description: Softens the directional boundary in degrees.
Params.Tooltip: This is an angular softness, not a normalized range feather.

Types.Name: Curvature
Types.Description: Selects convex and concave terrain based on local second-order height change.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Range of normalized curvature magnitude to include.
Params.Tooltip: Higher curvature magnitude indicates stronger local bowls or ridges.

Params.Name: CurvatureSensitivity
Params.Label: Curvature sensitivity
Params.Description: Controls how quickly raw curvature reaches the normalized response.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this when the preview is mostly black; reduce it when nearly everything is white.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the normalized curvature interval.
Params.Tooltip: A moderate feather avoids isolated one-pixel curvature spots.

Types.Name: Roughness / local variance
Types.Description: Selects areas with strong local height variation.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Local roughness response interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: Useful for separating smooth ground from scree and rock detail.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the roughness interval relative to its width.
Params.Tooltip: Use a larger feather for broad material transitions.

Types.Name: Flatness
Types.Description: Selects relatively level ground using the inverse of normalized slope.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Flatness interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: Values near one are flatter; values near zero are steeper.

Params.Name: SampleRadius
Params.Label: Slope sample radius
Params.Description: Controls the neighborhood used for the flatness estimate.
Params.Tooltip: Larger values make the result more suitable for broad settlement or farmland masks.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the flatness interval.
Params.Tooltip: Avoids a harsh boundary between level and sloped terrain.

Types.Name: Ridge / valley
Types.Description: Selects strong positive or negative local curvature features.

Params.Name: Feature
Params.Label: Feature
Params.Description: Chooses convex ridges or concave valleys.
Params.Tooltip: Ridge and valley strength are evaluated from the same stable curvature signal.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Minimum feature strength
Params.Description: Minimum normalized ridge or valley response to include.
Params.Tooltip: Raise this to reject weak broad curvature and keep only pronounced features.

Params.Name: CurvatureSensitivity
Params.Label: Curvature sensitivity
Params.Description: Controls the conversion from raw curvature to feature strength.
Params.Tooltip: Tune this before changing the minimum feature strength.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Feature feather
Params.Description: Softens the minimum feature threshold.
Params.Tooltip: A small feather gives stable feature edges without spreading the mask across the whole terrain.

Types.Name: Coastline / sea-level band
Types.Description: Selects a band of terrain heights around a configurable sea level.

Params.Name: SeaLevel
Params.Label: Sea level
Params.Description: Height treated as the coastline reference level.
Params.Tooltip: Move this to match the waterline of the current terrain.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Height band
Params.Description: Signed height interval around sea level to include.
Params.Tooltip: Negative values are below sea level and positive values are above it.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the two edges of the coastal height band.
Params.Tooltip: Use a modest feather to avoid a hard shoreline seam.

Types.Name: Distance from coast
Types.Description: Selects terrain by absolute height distance from the sea level reference.

Params.Name: SeaLevel
Params.Label: Sea level
Params.Description: Height treated as the coastline reference level.
Params.Tooltip: Set this to the same level used by the water or coastline mask.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Distance range
Params.Description: Absolute height distance from sea level to include.
Params.Tooltip: This is height distance in terrain units, not map-space distance.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the distance band edges.
Params.Tooltip: Keep this below half the range width for a controlled transition.

Types.Name: Flow accumulation / wetness
Types.Description: Approximates wet lowlands using local depression, low height, and gentle slope signals.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Combined wetness response interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: This is a local wetness approximation, not a full hydrology simulation.

Params.Name: SampleRadius
Params.Label: Slope sample radius
Params.Description: Controls the neighborhood used for the supporting slope estimate.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to make wetness less sensitive to tiny surface noise.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the wetness interval.
Params.Tooltip: A moderate feather helps connect nearby wet areas.

Types.Name: Ambient occlusion / cavity
Types.Description: Selects sheltered depressions where the surrounding terrain is higher than the sample.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Cavity response interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: The response is normalized from a local multi-sample depression estimate.

Params.Name: CavitySensitivity
Params.Label: Cavity sensitivity
Params.Description: Controls how quickly a depression reaches the normalized cavity response.
Params.Tooltip: Lower it when the mask is overwhelmingly white; raise it when cavities are too faint.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the cavity response interval.
Params.Tooltip: This controls the selected response range, not the cavity sampling radius.

Types.Name: Exposure
Types.Description: Selects terrain whose slope gradient faces a chosen direction and falls inside a response range.

Params.Name: Direction
Params.Label: Direction
Params.Description: Preferred windward or sun-facing direction in degrees.
Params.Tooltip: Use this for exposed slopes, windward terrain, or sun-facing vegetation.

Params.Name: DirectionWidth
Params.Label: Direction width
Params.Description: Angular width around the preferred direction.
Params.Tooltip: Wider values include more orientations before the response range is applied.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Normalized range
Params.Description: Exposure response interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: The exposure signal is derived from gradient alignment.

Params.Name: SampleRadius
Params.Label: Slope sample radius
Params.Description: Controls the neighborhood used for the exposure gradient.
Params.Tooltip: Larger values produce a calmer, broader exposure mask.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Feathers the normalized exposure interval.
Params.Tooltip: Use a small value for directional material boundaries.

Types.Name: Distance from border
Types.Description: Selects terrain by normalized distance from the nearest map edge.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Distance range
Params.Description: Normalized distance from the border to include.
Params.Tooltip: Useful for island falloff, edge cleanup, and border-aware detailing.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the border-distance interval.
Params.Tooltip: This feather is relative to the selected normalized distance range.

Types.Name: Distance from point / path
Types.Description: Selects terrain near a normalized map point or an editable polyline path.

Params.Name: UsePath
Params.Label: Use point path
Params.Description: Use the path editor instead of a single center point.
Params.Tooltip: The path is evaluated as the minimum distance to any segment.

Params.Name: Center
Params.Label: Center
Params.Description: Normalized map coordinate used when point-path mode is disabled.
Params.Tooltip: The origin is the bottom-left of the normalized map.

Params.Name: Path
Params.Label: Path editor
Params.Description: Shape a reusable normalized polyline with draggable handles.
Params.Tooltip: Drag handles to reshape the path. Double-click empty space to add a point; double-click a handle to remove it.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Distance range
Params.Description: Distance interval from the point or path to include.
Params.Tooltip: The distance is measured in normalized map coordinates.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the distance interval relative to its width.
Params.Tooltip: Use a small feather to keep narrow roads or river corridors defined.

Types.Name: Height contour band
Types.Description: Selects terrain in a height band, useful for terraces and geological strata.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Height band
Params.Description: Height interval used for the contour band.
Params.Tooltip: Narrow bands isolate a contour; widen it to make a broader geological layer.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens both sides of the height contour band.
Params.Tooltip: A modest feather avoids a pixel-hard contour edge.

Types.Name: Procedural noise
Types.Description: Creates a deterministic breakup mask from the shared procedural noise library.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Label: Noise scale
Params.Description: Sampling scale of the procedural breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create smaller, more frequent patches.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Label: Noise seed
Params.Description: Deterministically changes the procedural noise pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different breakup layout without changing its scale.

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise algorithm
Params.Description: Selects the shared noise model used to build the mask.

Params.Name: NoiseOctaves
Params.Label: Noise octaves
Params.Description: Controls how many frequency layers are combined.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add detail at a higher shader cost.

Params.Name: NoiseLacunarity
Params.Label: Noise lacunarity
Params.Description: Controls the frequency multiplier between layers.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values separate the detail scales more strongly.

Params.Name: NoisePersistence
Params.Label: Noise persistence
Params.Description: Controls how much amplitude each layer retains.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values keep more fine detail visible.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise warp
Params.Description: Bends the sampling domain before evaluating noise.
Params.Tooltip: Use this to make otherwise regular patterns more organic.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise jitter
Params.Description: Offsets feature points for the mask's cellular patterns.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local feature placement.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Noise range
Params.Description: Noise response interval to include.
Params.Tooltip: The range controls which noise values become active.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the selected noise response interval.
Params.Tooltip: Use a larger value for less binary breakup.

Types.Name: Radial / gradient
Types.Description: Selects a circular band around a normalized map center.

Params.Name: Center
Params.Label: Center
Params.Description: Normalized center of the radial mask.
Params.Tooltip: The center can be moved outside the map only by using a different mask type.

Params.Name: Range
Params.Label: Distance range
Params.Description: Inner and outer normalized radius of the radial gradient.
Params.Tooltip: The mask is strongest inside the inner radius and fades out past the outer radius.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the radial band as a fraction of its width.
Params.Tooltip: This keeps the gradient proportional when the radius changes.
